scope: Eleven bounded semantic groups; historical raw-hunk IDs and dispositions retained. Counts are not independent language changes. Outside-ledger compiler/optimizer files have no harmless default.

groups.name: Assignment-result writable dispatch
groups.semanticPurpose: Propagate BP_VAR contexts and distinguish TMP ordinary assignment from VAR reference results; list result retains the evaluated RHS kind.
groups.sourceAcceptance: RC4 compilation accepts new assignment-derived write paths. TMP/CONST containers reach VM handlers supporting VAR/CV only. Property, read-modify-write, unset and reference-fetch failures extend PHP86-014; intended repair remains undecided.
groups.remaining: Authoritative intended-validity decision and exact-pin execution for each operation/result kind; opcache/JIT/debug-build profiles remain untested. Do not generalize successful reference results.

groups.name: Optimized printf dispatch
groups.semanticPurpose: Attempt printf-to-echo/rope lowering using constant evaluation of the format, then sprintf specialization and ordinary fallback.
groups.sourceAcceptance: Both acceptance directions depend on visited AST and dispatch. Named/unpacked calls bypass the special-function selector; array literal compilation can independently evaluate constants.
groups.remaining: No exact upstream PHPT for discarded casts identified. The listed array_map test supports adjacent dispatch only. Intended compatibility policy and full optimized-call interactions remain open under PHP86-015.

groups.name: Constant callable AST traversal
groups.semanticPurpose: Carry PFA arguments through callable markers, traverse them during constant folding and bind constant values when AST evaluation creates the partial.
groups.sourceAcceptance: Constant folding visits both logical operands, but may discard an enclosing known conditional. Live constant closure bodies use ordinary function compilation. AST evaluation additionally rejects bound non-placeholder values for mandatory-reference parameters.
groups.remaining: Existing PHP86-001 constraints remain supported. Full named/reference binding, evaluation timing and optimized partial-application interaction coverage is not established by lint; runtime signatures remain open.

groups.name: Constant-name and coalesce unreachable paths
groups.semanticPurpose: Replace EMPTY_SWITCH_DEFAULT_CASE with its ZEND_UNREACHABLE expansion; remove return after noreturn fatal; use C bool and const qualifiers.
groups.sourceAcceptance: The old macro expands to default: ZEND_UNREACHABLE(); break. Every actual case, condition and fatal check is retained. This is an exact-hunk exclusion, not a rule for arbitrary switch rewrites.
groups.remaining: None for the reviewed source edits. No claim about unrelated coalesce/reference optimizations.

groups.name: Attribute validator fatal-tail cleanup
groups.semanticPurpose: Remove zend_string_efree(error) after zend_error_noreturn; preserve delayed validation_error assignment.
groups.sourceAcceptance: No reachable validation or target check changes. Override target expansion is a separate PHP86-005 change, not an effect of this deletion.
groups.remaining: None for this unreachable cleanup. No blanket exclusion of attribute predicates.

groups.name: Closure capture diagnostics and iteration
groups.semanticPurpose: Use checked escaped-string diagnostics for duplicate capture, const-qualified local reads and explicit braces around the same hash iteration.
groups.sourceAcceptance: The duplicate-name lookup/failure and emitted lexical bindings remain unchanged; no new capture permission. Live/discarded and implicit capture controls agree.
groups.remaining: None for these exact changes. Diagnostic byte rendering is not certified.

groups.name: Interface installation and deferred linking

phase3d.limitation: No new language rule identified beyond PHP86-005; interface-order/autoload interactions remain unresolved under PHP86-013.
No new language rule identified beyond PHP86-005; interface-order/autoload interactions remain unresolved under PHP86-013.

groups.semanticPurpose: Install inherited interfaces before member checks. Prior Phase 3D direct graph review is retained; this phase tests autoloaded parents and inherited interface constants.
groups.sourceAcceptance: Reviewed inline autoload programs preserve covariance rejection/acceptance and the PHP86-005 Override boundary. php -l cannot certify autoload-time linking.
groups.remaining: Reentrant callbacks that request a partially linked class, cycles and failure recovery remain unisolated. Four programs reduce the simple autoload gap, not all reentrant linking.

groups.name: Enum initializer case-ID layout
groups.semanticPurpose: Add an internal case ID between class and case name; expand the AST from three to four children and move backing-value evaluation from child 2 to child 3.
groups.sourceAcceptance: Construction, compile-time traversal and runtime evaluation agree on the new slot. Case IDs are engine metadata, not new enum source syntax. Backing-value type rejection remains separate from structural parsing.
groups.remaining: No additional syntax impact for this representation change. Not a certification of enum object storage, internal C APIs or all optimizer consumers.

groups.name: Enum Override deferred validation
groups.semanticPurpose: Set ZEND_ACC_OVERRIDE and mark enum constants for deferred validation.
groups.sourceAcceptance: Associates a previously pending compiler hunk with implemented PHP86-005. Existing Attributes/Enums clauses and paired valid/missing-target cases describe the change. No new correction is identified.
groups.remaining: Implementation identification is resolved; comprehensive declaration/link validation remains a separate outstanding project capability.

groups.name: Static closure cache eligibility
groups.semanticPurpose: Allocate a cache slot for explicitly static closures without static variables inside a declaring function, after zend_compile_stmt has compiled the body.
groups.sourceAcceptance: Does not introduce automatic static inference or skip body validation. Retained duplicate capture still rejects; discarded closure still avoids compilation before cache eligibility.
groups.remaining: No source-acceptance impact from this cache-slot block. Object identity, cache lifetime and optimizer runtime behavior remain outside this exclusion.

groups.name: Inherited hook-name policy
groups.semanticPurpose: Reconcile historical get/set-only EBNF with parser T_STRING and visited-declaration compiler checking.
groups.sourceAcceptance: Both versions accept discarded unknown hooks at lint; both repository grammars deliberately reject them. Historical php.md explicitly documents the divergence. This is not an RC4-only defect.
groups.remaining: No correction in this phase. Any change to literal compiler-acceptance equivalence requires separate historical-correction governance and explicit implementation authorization.
